svg.text: Module 08 — Docker fixed packaging. It did not fix the machine.
restart: always keeps a dead CONTAINER alive
nothing keeps a dead MACHINE alive
The machine goes away and so does
holds desired state, watches actual state
node 2 dies -> its pods are recreated
Traffic stops going to them within seconds.
The idea that changes everything: a reconciliation loop
Everything so far has been imperative. You told the machine what to DO — run this, install that, restart this.
If the command succeeded, good. If the world changed afterwards, nothing noticed.
An orchestrator is declarative. You record what SHOULD be true — three copies of this image, always.
A controller then compares that to what IS true, forever, and acts on every difference it finds.
Self-healing, scaling and rolling updates are not separate features. They are all the same loop.
